name: Always post loud
description: When 1, lit (displayed) posting is always allowed: ExchangeMaster picks aggression level POST instead of the region/ADV-based post-blind logic, PostWorker marks the order as able to post loud, and ConcertStrategy.noPostLoud() returns false (any value > 0) even for NINJA or clean-pipe 63 orders.

example.explanation: Allow displayed lit posts regardless of the post-blind rules.

algorithmDependent.behavior: NINJA normally never posts loud; with 120>0 noPostLoud() returns false before the NINJA check, so lit posting venues are set up.
ExchangeMaster's earlier NINJA/shadow branch (POSTBLIND) is evaluated before the 120 check, so the order-level aggression stays POSTBLIND for those cases.

interactions.title: 120 re-enables lit posting for NINJA and clean-pipe 63
interactions.explanation: ConcertStrategy.noPostLoud() checks always_post_loud first and returns false, so NINJA's and cleanPipe()==63's 'no post loud' rule (tag 213) is bypassed.

interactions.title: 120 does not change ExchangeMaster aggression for NINJA/shadow
interactions.explanation: In ExchangeMaster the NINJA / shadow (no min part or shadowmin_post_loud<=0) branch sets POSTBLIND before the always_post_loud==1 branch is reached.

name: Random lot size
description: Randomises the size of normal (non-auction) candidates by up to +/- rmax shares, rounded to lots, where rmax = min(max lots * round lot, fwork * workable shares, fhard * hard size). Only applied when hard size > 1.5*rmax and enough workable shares remain. Without the tag the values come from AlgoConfig, but only for algorithms in random_lotsize_algos (otherwise 0 = off).
default: random_lotsize_max=5, random_lotsize_fhard=0.5, random_lotsize_fwork=0.05 (AlgoConfig) for algos in random_lotsize_algos, else 0

example.explanation: Jitter each candidate by at most 3 lots, 30% of hard size, 5% of workable shares.

interactions.title: Explicit 121 enables size randomisation for any algorithm
interactions.explanation: Setting the tag bypasses the AlgoConfig random_lotsize_algos check in the accessors, so randomisation applies even to algos where it is off by default.

name: IIS email mode
description: Integer flag stored as iis_email_mode; in the Java source it is only printed in the parameter summary. Its effect (presumably e-mail notifications for IIS orders) is not visible in the code read.

example.explanation: Set IIS email mode 1.

name: Random min exec size
description: Randomises the minimum execution quantity sent on child orders. The min exec size is drawn between min(min exec size, value) and the configured min exec size; mode 1 uses a uniform random draw, otherwise the draw is skewed by the order's participation progress. below_lot controls whether the result may fall below a round lot (1: below-lot values are kept or rounded up to one lot at random; 2: odd-lot min exec allowed).

allowedValues.meaning: skewed by accumulated participation rate vs min/max part levels
may go below a round lot / to 0, still round lot

example.explanation: Min exec randomly between 200 shares and the normal min exec size.

interactions.title: 123 only acts when a min exec size is already in effect
interactions.explanation: Randomisation runs only if param_minexecsize > 0 (from min exec / min exec value / dynamic min exec tag 142).

name: Dark pool count
description: Number of dark pools used in parallel. Either a plain integer, or an ADV-scaled form 'base,T,advM' giving count = max(3, ceil(stockADV/(advM*1e6 + stockADV) * base)); a value starting with 'T' uses AlgoConfig darkpool_count as base, a value ending in 'T' appends ',10'. Resolved per stock at setup and read by CandidateProcessor, ExchangeMaster, ConcertStrategy, IoIWorker and LCOddLotWorker.

example.explanation: Config base count scaled by ADV vs 10M.

name: Use take-ping
description: When > 0, the take worker also sets up TAKEPING venues (filtered by clean-pipe rules) before taking; if darkping mode (DPM) is 3 it uses DARKPING venues instead. Used in ConcertStrategy and NDMAStrategy.

example.explanation: Ping TAKEPING venues as part of taking.

interactions.title: DPM=3 switches take-ping to dark-ping venues
interactions.explanation: With use_takeping>0 and darkping_mode()==3 the engine uses AggressionLevel.DARKPING venues instead of TAKEPING (code comment: '9012=DPM=3^152=1^25=0' for GMO2).

name: Cash price mode
description: Selects the price used to value candidates in cash-balanced (portfolio) processing: 1 = strike last price (falls back to previous close) times FX, 3 = previous close times FX, otherwise the live last price times FX (strike/prev close if no quote).

example.explanation: Value cash legs at previous close.

name: Input timezone mode
description: Says which timezone the start/end times (9002/9003 etc.) are given in, so the engine converts them to the trading-server timezone. 1 = exchange local time, 2 = configured input timezone, 3 = GMT, or a timezone ID string (mode 4). An invalid ID leaves the timezone null and the order fails validation with 'invalid input time zone'.

example.explanation: Start/end times in the exchange's local time.

interactions.title: Bad timezone ID rejects the order
interactions.explanation: Modes >1 need a valid timezone; if the ID string does not match the resolved TimeZone, _input_timezone is null and checkForError() returns 'invalid input time zone'.

interactions.title: Rule disables open auction for orders starting after the open auction
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:309 sets 14=0 when a start time is given, 127 is not 3, and the start is at/after the earliest open auction.

interactions.title: FMRPOP AU rules set 127=1
interactions.explanation: Rules for clientAlgorithm FMRPOP in AU write 127=1 so their 9002=10:30:00 is read as local time.

name: FX mode
description: Controls FX handling for pair/cross-currency orders. Values <= 2 require pair spread units when the two legs have different currencies (otherwise the portfolio is rejected PAIRNEEDUNIT); > 2 skips that check; > 3 forces fx_rate to 1.0. Unset falls back to AlgoConfig fx_mode.

example.explanation: Ignore FX conversion.

interactions.title: Cross-currency pair without units is rejected
interactions.explanation: When fx_mode<=2 and the pair's currencies differ, checkPairUnits() may return an error and the portfolio is rejected with PAIRNEEDUNIT.

name: Cash hold post mode
description: For cash-balanced baskets: when the cash-balancing scale factor is ~0, hard and min sizes are always zeroed, but with a value > 0 the candidate keeps its max/workable (passive post) size instead of being zeroed.

example.explanation: Keep resting posts when cash balance halts the side.

name: Cash lag side
description: Marks which side of a cash-balanced basket is the lagging side: 1 = buy side lags, 2 = sell side lags, 0/3 other modes (>3 is coerced to 0). The lag side's candidates are scaled by the cash-balance ratio, get maxsize = hardsize, skip the regulator's part-rate check and are not added to CandidateRegulator; 0 makes the cash-balance step scale candidates with factor 0.

allowedValues.meaning: both sides scaled to 0 in cash balancing

example.explanation: Sell side follows the buy side.

name: PEG limit / peg offset
description: Either a plain peg limit value, or 'mode,delta' that shifts the PEG price more aggressively from the peg reference: mode 1 = delta bps of price, 2 = delta cents, 3 = delta ticks, 4 = delta fraction of the average spread, 5 = peg to midpoint. The plain value is exported as order info 'peg_limit' and is also the reference price used to convert a bps discretion in tag 132.

example.explanation: Peg one tick more aggressive than the peg level.

algorithmDependent.behavior: The offset is applied in PegWorker.computePegPrice only when algotype is PEG and mode 1-5.

interactions.title: Peg offset modes only work for PEG
interactions.explanation: computePegPrice applies the offset only if the order's algotype is PEG.

name: PEG take discretion
description: Discretion for a PEG order to take liquidity: the take price is the near-side (passive) price plus this amount; when that reaches the far touch the PEG takes. Parsed as BpsCps with default unit cents; converted to cents-per-share using the tag 131 value as the reference price. How much is taken depends on peg take mode (tag 186): 0 = stop peg and take all workable, 1 = take the peg candidate size, >1 = add a separate take candidate for the shares not pegged.

example.explanation: Take when the far side is within 2 cents of the peg's passive price.

interactions.title: Take behaviour depends on peg take mode 186
interactions.explanation: PegWorker.tryTake handles mode 0/1; with 186>1 ConcertStrategy.handlePEGTakeDiscretion adds a take candidate instead.

interactions.title: bps discretion without 131 converts to 0
interactions.explanation: Discretion is converted with cpsInDollar(_peg_limit); _peg_limit is the tag 131 value, so a bps-based discretion needs 131 set to a price.

name: SOR duration
description: SOR duration either as an integer or ADV-scaled 'base,T,advM' giving max(3, ceil(advM*1e6/(advM*1e6+stockADV) * base)); 'T' prefix uses AlgoConfig sor_duration_base (5). The resolved sor_duration() is only logged in the parameter summary; no consumer was found in the Java source.

example.explanation: Config base scaled by ADV vs 10M.

name: Lag side aggression
description: Double stored as lag_side_aggression (cash basket lag side). Only printed in the parameter summary; no consumer found in the Java source.

example.explanation: Lag side aggression 0.5.

name: New shadow initial aggression
description: Aggression used during a new-shadow order's initial phase: price = mid +/- min(1.5 * agg * spread, 0.5*spread + 2 ticks). Defaults to AlgoConfig newshadow_init_agg.

example.explanation: Start at the midpoint.

name: Small quote size threshold
description: If the far-side (inside aggressive) quote size is below this threshold, child orders to PMID/dark venues are capped at the passive price level from tag 137. The order accessor returns the tag value only (0 = off); AlgoConfig small_quote_size_thresh=500 is not used as a fallback by this accessor.

example.explanation: Below 1000 shares on the far side, cap dark prices at the passive level.

interactions.title: Uses 137 passive level
interactions.explanation: The cap price is small_quote_passive_level (tag 137, default AlgoConfig 'QUOTE').

name: Small quote passive level
description: Tick-price level (e.g. QUOTE) used to cap PMID/dark child prices when the far-side quote is smaller than tag 136.

example.explanation: Cap at the same-side quote.

interactions.title: 137 has no effect without 136
interactions.explanation: Only used when small_quote_size_thresh (136) > far-side quote size; 136 defaults to 0.

name: Lead side rate
description: Double stored as lead_side_rate (cash basket lead side). Only printed in the parameter summary; no consumer found in the Java source.

example.explanation: Lead side rate 0.1.

name: Compound algo mode
description: Selects how a COMPOUND order switches between the legs in 9060. 2/3 = time-based (CompoundTimeTracker; mode 2 drops the first leg if the stock has not opened); 1/7 = position (fill %) based, 7 measures against volume; 6 = split (COMPOUNDSPLIT); 5 = portfolio/pair tracker (appends 1=PAIR to legs); other numbers < 100 = price-based CompoundAlgoTracker; a non-numeric name = a named compound trigger from RelayScheduler (mode 100). Optional second field = stop leg index.

allowedValues.meaning: time based, drop first leg if pre-open

example.explanation: Switch legs by time as listed in 9060.

interactions.title: Unknown trigger name rejects
interactions.explanation: A non-numeric value that is not a known compound trigger sets _err_msg 'invalid compound algo mode tag139'.

interactions.title: Needs compound config 9060
interactions.explanation: Trackers are only built when _compound_config (from 9060) is set; otherwise no compound relay algorithm is created.

interactions.title: CIS / LADDER / STOPLOSS overwrite 139
interactions.explanation: convertCIS (IIS algos with 188) forces mode 3; convertLadder (197) and convertStopLoss (210) force mode 0 and rebuild the compound config.

interactions.title: Mode 2 skips first leg pre-open
interactions.explanation: With mode 2 the time tracker is adjusted by stock.opened(), so an order arriving before the open loses its first (auction) leg; docs recommend mode 3.

interactions.title: Mode 5 turns legs into PAIR
interactions.explanation: Subparameters get '^1=PAIR' appended and inherit pair tags; tag 62 defaults to the tracker's first threshold.

name: PEG dark mode
description: Lets a PEG order also use dark pools. 0 = regular peg, no dark; 1 = use dark with normal pricing (peg size halved to leave dark max size); 2 = use dark while pegging (dark and post limit = quote, dark orders treated out-of-money when outside the spread); 3 = same as 0.
default: 0 in code; ai.fixmsg.properties:108 sets 1 for PEG when unset

example.explanation: PEG with dark pool participation.

interactions.title: Rule defaults PEG dark mode to 1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:108 writes 140=1 for every PEG order without 140.

interactions.title: No dark (152) resets PEG dark mode to 0
interactions.explanation: When no dark worker is created (no_dark or no dark venues), ConcertStrategy resets peg_dark_mode to 0. E.g. HK short-sell SDMA converted to PEG gets 152=1 (line 6) and then 140=1 (line 108), which is reset.

name: PEG post venue
description: Forces the venue for peg candidates; with it set, PegWorker only sends a new order when it has no live orders (one live peg order at a time).

example.explanation: Post pegs only to that venue.

name: Dynamic min exec size
description: Overrides the child min exec size with min(value, floor(order size/500)*100), never above an existing min exec size.

example.explanation: Min exec up to 1000 shares, scaled by order size.

name: Ninja2 post mode
description: For shadow/ninja-like algos, a value > 0 enables lit posting (ninja2post): noPostLoud() returns false and PostWorker treats the order like ICENINJA for post-loud checks.

example.explanation: Let a NINJA-like order post on lit venues.

interactions.title: Only for shadow/ninja-like algos
interactions.explanation: ninja2post() requires algo().likeShadowNinja().

name: Number of post layers
description: Number of price layers used by the layered queue post worker (queue mode, tag 154>0). For non-scheduled algos without max participation it also multiplies the queue hard size. Defaults to OEO config num_post_layers.

example.explanation: Single layer queue.

interactions.title: Layers only used in queue mode
interactions.explanation: LayeredPostWorker is created only when queue_mode (154) > 0.

interactions.title: Rules default 144=1 in KS/China and for GRANTHAM/MK short-sell
interactions.explanation: Rules write 144=1 for KS and C1/C2/CH, GRANTHAM queue orders with low max part, and MK short-sell with 154=1.

name: Cost save mode
description: Integer exported in the order info map as 'cost_save_mode' (consumed outside this Java code). Default is 0 for cash baskets (doCash>0) and 1 otherwise.

example.explanation: Disable cost save mode.

name: Honor end time (clean-up)
description: When > 0, the engine finishes (cleans up) the leftover near the end time: if within the must-complete buffer of the end time (or, for non-scheduled algos, no fill for the stock wait time), open shares <= a clean-up threshold (config cleanup_pct/rls/aqs), within the participation cap and within the clean-up spread threshold (tag 185). Sends a CLEANUPLEFTOVER alert. Not applied when halted or passive-only no-take.

allowedValues.meaning: clean up leftover near end time

example.explanation: Take out small leftover before end time.

interactions.title: Rules enable 146 for VWAP/TMX
interactions.explanation: 146=1 is written for VWAP/TMX ending before continuous end (not short-sell, not APIL/APIM), SILK baskets without close, and IN orders with no max part and no close.

interactions.title: Passive-only no-take blocks clean-up
interactions.explanation: The clean-up branch requires !passive_only_notake(0).

name: Include EOD candidate
description: 0 removes candidates whose venue contains 'EOD' and disables purestream EOD mode 1. Default 0 for cash baskets, 1 otherwise.

example.explanation: No EOD venue candidates.

interactions.title: Disables purestream EOD mode 1
interactions.explanation: purestream_eod_mode() returns 0 when mode is 1 and include_eod_candidate()==0.

interactions.title: Rule sets 147=0 for prorate orders
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:505 writes 147=0^OCASH=0 when prorate_mode>0 (not APIL/APIM).

name: Tilt parameters
description: alpha,beta[,mode] stored as tilt_alpha/tilt_beta/tilt_mode. Accessors exist but no consumer was found in the Java source; meaning unknown (likely schedule tilt). Fewer than two fields throws a parse error.

example.explanation: Tilt alpha 0.1, beta 0.2, mode 1.

name: More dark
description: Integer exported in the order info map as 'more_dark' (consumed outside this Java code, presumably to favour dark venues).

example.explanation: Request more dark.

name: Count dual-listed volume
description: When > 0 and the stock has a dual listing, volume of the dual listing is included in market stats and the volume profile (vprof_sym becomes 'sym,dualSym'); opening logic may use the dual stock. Forced to >= 1 when dual trade (tag 202) is on or for the synthetic India router; forced to 0 if the stock has no dual listing.

example.explanation: Count volume on both IB and IS.

interactions.title: Dual trade forces 150 on
interactions.explanation: count_duallist_volume() returns max(value,1) when dual_trade()>0.

name: Preempt volume mode
description: When > 0 the order's market stats add 'preempt' volume (bid+ask size times config preempt_volume_quote_ratio, or 1-minute volume share) so participation sizing anticipates volume.

example.explanation: Anticipate volume.

name: No dark
description: When > 0 the order uses no dark pools: no dark (pmid) worker or dark-take pings are set up. Shadow algos then have no dark pool and are rejected NO_DARKPOOL unless they use IOIs exclusively; PEG dark mode is reset to 0.

example.explanation: Lit only.

interactions.title: Shadow with no dark is rejected
interactions.explanation: With no dark worker, a shadow algo not using IOI exclusively is rejected with NO_DARKPOOL.

interactions.title: HK short-sell SDMA becomes PEG with 152=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:6 converts HK short-sell SDMA to PEG and sets 152=1; the default 140=1 from line 108 is then reset to 0.

name: Compound VWAP config
description: Configuration string for the COMPOUNDVWAP client algorithm's CompoundVWAPTracker. Used only when the client algorithm is COMPOUNDVWAP and no other compound/scale/index tracker applies; an invalid string rejects with 'incorrect compound vwap tracker'.

example.explanation: Not documented in code read.

interactions.title: Invalid compound vwap string rejects
interactions.explanation: If the tracker built from 153 should not track, _err_msg='incorrect compound vwap tracker'.

interactions.title: Ignored when another compound tracker exists
interactions.explanation: COMPOUNDVWAP is the last branch of the relay-algorithm else-if chain.

name: Queue mode
description: Selects the posting worker. 0 = normal PostWorker; > 0 = layered queue worker (LayeredPostWorker, layers from tag 144) plus a simple post worker; < 0 = no post worker. 3 behaves as 2 when out of money else 1; 4 as 2 when outside spread else 1; >= 2 uses a shorter part-rate monitoring window. In queue mode passive-only 2 sets max size 0 and totalPassiveShares is 0.
default: 0 in code; many rules set it

example.explanation: Queue with layered posts.

interactions.title: Rules default 154=1 for VWAP/PART but later rules reset to 0
interactions.explanation: Line 49 sets 154=1; later unguarded rules write 154=0 for C1/C2/CH, ICENINJA, IN, MAYBANK, APIH maxPartLevel<1 and HK/MK short-sell APIH (conflict C-17).

interactions.title: Queue + passive-only 2 zeroes max size
interactions.explanation: CandidateProcessor sets maxsize=0 when passive_only()==2 and queue_mode>0.

name: Broker spec
description: Restricts venues by broker/venue id per aggression level: '&'-separated entries 'AGGR1,AGGR2;BRK1,BRK2' or just 'BRK1,BRK2' (all levels), plus 'CHECKOFF;...' / 'IGNOREOFF;...' controlling whether venue shut-off/custom-venue checks still apply, and an EXCEPT key. Upper-cased; listed venues get their weight even if 0. When set, the normal enabled-exchange filtering (shut-off, primary-only) is skipped. Values like SG, HKEX, MAYBANK are used as conditions by many rules.

example.explanation: Take and post only via broker SG.

interactions.title: Broker spec bypasses venue shut-off and primary-only filters
interactions.explanation: enabledExchangesRaw returns all tradeable venues when broker_spec_map is set; shut-off checks only run for aggression levels marked CHECKOFF.

interactions.title: 155=SG drives many rule defaults
interactions.explanation: Rules key on 155=SG/HKEX/MAYBANK: skip LOR/LCR defaults when SG, set IN settings (MAXCD, ERB, PMS, TECT), 154=0^MWORK=1 for MAYBANK, HK short-sell DMAPPL/LORT/PPL for HKEX/SG.

name: Grab mode
description: Opportunistic 'grab' of liquidity: price,quotesize,shares[P][,aggr[,cap[,interval_sec]]]. price is a level (number, or ending in B/C/S, S needing a spread); quotesize may be SW/AW/BW/LW for sweep modes; shares ending in P is a percent of order, negative = mode 3; aggr is 0-1; cap may be prefixed C and suffixed P. Child orders are flagged with would-flag 6/7.

example.explanation: Grab up to 20% of the order when price is within 10 bps and size >= 500.

interactions.title: Invalid grab price rejects
interactions.explanation: A zero numeric grab price (unless allow_no_grab_price), or an S price without average spread, sets _err_msg and disables grab.

interactions.title: Rule sets 173=0 with grab
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:360 writes 173=0 to prevent dynamic passive-only when a grab is requested.

name: Index tracker OOM mode
description: Integer stored as the index-tracker out-of-money mode. In the available source it is only echoed in the parameter dump when an index tracker is configured; no engine logic reading indexTrackerOOMMode() was found.

example.explanation: Sets itk_oom_mode=1 (no visible effect in the source read).

name: Broker-directed size
description: Number of shares to direct to the broker list given in 163. 0 (or equal to the order size) means the whole order is broker-directed: venue selection is restricted to (or excludes, see 159) the listed brokers. A value between 0 and the order size splits the order into a BrokerDirect strategy for that many shares plus a normal strategy for the rest.

example.explanation: Direct 5,000 shares of a larger order to the brokers in 163; the remainder trades normally.

interactions.title: Broker-directed size above order size rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError returns 'broker directed size > order size', which rejects the order.

interactions.title: Broker-directed size needs a broker list (163)
interactions.explanation: All broker-direct logic checks broker_direct_list(), which is built only from 163; without 163 the size has no effect.

interactions.title: Partial broker direction splits the order into two strategies
interactions.explanation: When 0 < 158 < order size a second strategy ('BrokerDirect') is created; BrokerDirectStrategy splits the goal so the directed strategy works up to 158 shares and the other works the rest.

name: Broker-direct exclude
description: Flips the meaning of the broker list in 163: 0 = only route to the listed brokers (exch.sbroker()), non-zero = route to every broker except the listed ones.

example.explanation: Never route to the brokers listed in 163.

interactions.title: Exclude flag needs a broker list (163)
interactions.explanation: The flag is only consulted when broker_direct_list() (built from 163) is non-null.

name: PEG mode
description: Integer PEG mode. In the source read it is only stored in the order-info map ('peg_mode') published by OrderHolder and in the parameter dump; no other engine logic was found.

example.explanation: Publishes peg_mode=1 in order info.

name: Post layer price increment
description: Overrides the increment used between posting layers in ConcertStrategy: when > 0 it replaces the default layer step 'a'.

example.explanation: Use 0.5 as the posting layer increment.

name: Check open mode / OPE open mode
description: Controls how the engine decides the stock has opened. Value < 10: check_open_mode, pushed onto the stock (setCheckOpenMode) if higher than the stock's current mode, and used to mark the stock open from an initial transaction. Value >= 10: tens digit = ope_open_mode (stock treated as opened ope_open_buffer ms after continuous/PM session start, buffer from 320; mode > 1 forces at least 1s), units digit = check_open_mode.

allowedValues.meaning: ope_open_mode=1, check_open_mode=0 (open by time buffer from 320)

example.explanation: Treat the stock as open once the 320 buffer has elapsed after the continuous session start.

interactions.title: OPE open mode uses 320 buffer to mark the stock open
interactions.explanation: With ope_open_mode > 0 the engine copies the stock and sets it opened/openedPM once now >= session start + ope_open_buffer (320, seconds).

interactions.title: Config sets 162=10 with a 320 buffer for most markets
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets 162=10 plus 320=300 (TB), 180 (KS), 1 (MK/HK/C1/C2/CH/IN/PM/SP DMA algos) or 60 (all non-JP) when neither is set.

interactions.title: Raises the stock-wide check-open mode
interactions.explanation: If the stock is not open and this order's check_open_mode is higher than the stock's, it is stored on the stock via the security master, affecting other orders on the same stock.

name: Broker-direct list
description: Comma-separated list of broker codes (matched against exch.sbroker()) to direct the order to; parsed into broker_direct_list. Combined with 158 (how many shares) and 159 (include/exclude).

example.explanation: Route only to venues of brokers BRK1 and BRK2.

interactions.title: Restricts venue selection to (or away from) listed brokers
interactions.explanation: When 158 is 0 or equals order size, venues whose broker is not in the list are rejected (or, with 159!=0, listed brokers are rejected); strategy id becomes 'BrokerDirected'.

name: MOO limit factor (sigma)
description: Number of volatility sigmas used to set the limit price of market-on-open orders around the base price. 0 together with LOR (1527) = 0 means no MOO limit offset (limit from ticks only). If unset, per-market AlgoConfig moo_limit_factor; forced to 0 when the stock's mooPriceType is 2.

example.explanation: MOO limit = base price +/- 3 sigma.

interactions.title: Config zeroes MOO limit factor for most markets
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 164=0 and LOR=0 when LOR is not set, outside NZ/PM/IJ/MK/C1/C2/CH/HK; also for HK zero-price or HK short-sell non-ETF orders; NZ/PM/IJ/MK get 164=10, LOR=0.1. Note the rule does not check whether 164 itself was set, so a client 164 is overwritten.

interactions.title: Ignored when stock mooPriceType is 2
interactions.explanation: moo_limit_factor() returns 0 if the stock's mooPriceType()==2.

name: Greedy mode
description: When > 0, TakeWorker treats the order like a fully aggressive WOW order (takes liquidity when there is a limit price), and for WOW orders in the money ConcertStrategy returns 0 from the relevant size check.

example.explanation: Take aggressively whenever in the money.

name: Cut-off (large print) size
description: Per-order trade-size cutoff stored in Parameters.cutOffSize(). The engine's large-print filter is size_cutoff_multiplier (184) x order cutOffSize; prints larger than that (outside auctions) are excluded from the participation volume. Rules use 166=1000000000 to effectively disable filtering. Whether SysOrder.cutOffSize() reads this parameter could not be verified (SysOrder source not present).
default: stock cutoff (9999/19999/39999 by region when absent)

example.explanation: Effectively disable large-print filtering.

interactions.title: Config adds 184=1 and 191=0.001 when 166 is set
interactions.explanation: Rules set 184=1 (multiplier 1) and 191=0.001 (quote multiplier negligible) when 166 is present and they are not, so the filter equals exactly the 166 size.

interactions.title: IPO orders get 166=1e9
interactions.explanation: IPO stocks get 184=1 and 166=1000000000 (no large-print filtering); also stocks with adv<1 and 184=1.

name: Monitor period
description: Monitoring period in seconds, with optional floor ('period,floor'). Only published in order info (monitor_period, monitor_period_flr) in the source read; consumed downstream.

example.explanation: Monitor period of 1.1 s.

interactions.title: Config sets 167=1 for APIH VWAP close orders, minimum 1.1
interactions.explanation: Rule sets 167=1 for VWAP with close in APIH near close; a later rule raises any monitor period between 0 and 1.1 to 1.1 (last writer wins).

name: Leading volume mode
description: When > 0, the average 1-minute volume is added as 'leading volume' to the volume estimates when the order market stats are updated (otherwise only on the first slice).

example.explanation: Always add the recent 1-minute volume as leading volume.

name: Bps from low/high cap
description: Caps the order price relative to today's range: buy limit = day high x (1 + bps/1e4), sell limit = day low x (1 - bps/1e4). Optional extra fields are aggression levels (e.g. dark, pmid); if any are listed the code sets an 'exception' flag that disables the low/high check entirely in withinLimit. Ignored when block_trade_filter > 0.

example.explanation: Cap at the day's high/low (0 bps); with aggression list given.

interactions.title: Config sets 169=0,dark,pmid for SHADOW
interactions.explanation: Non-fully-aggressive SHADOW orders get 169=0,dark,pmid by rule.

interactions.title: Aggression list disables the low/high price check
interactions.explanation: setBpsFromLowHigh sets _bps_from_low_high_exception=true when any aggression level is listed, and withinLimit only applies the cap when the exception flag is false.

name: Staff ID
description: Trader/staff identifier for the order. Used as traderID in published order maps, on portfolio client info, and in alerts (falls back to the system id when empty). May also be set from the configured staffid tag or client config.

example.explanation: Order attributed to trader JSMITH.

name: Do PM open (afternoon opening auction)
description: Participate in the afternoon (post-lunch) opening auction, analogous to 14 (open) and 15 (close). Ignored for stocks with no PM open. If there is no PM opening volume history and moopm_nohist is 0, the engine resets it to 0.

example.explanation: Send part of the order into the afternoon opening auction.

interactions.title: Config turns on PM open (171=1, OPEPMO=1) in JP/MK/TB/SP
interactions.explanation: Unless the client sets 171=0, rules enable PM open for most algos (and SHADOW/SHADOWMIN with min part level) in JP, MK, TB, SP.

interactions.title: AUCTIONS sets 14/15/171 together
interactions.explanation: AUCTIONS=0 writes 171=0, AUCTIONS=1 writes 171=1.

interactions.title: No effect where the stock has no PM open
interactions.explanation: doPMOpen() returns 0 if stock.noPMOpen().

interactions.title: IPO orders default 171=0
interactions.explanation: Rule writes 171=0 for IPOs when not set.

name: Take venue selector
description: Restricts TAKE allocations on 'ABOVE*' venues to a venue sub-type by id suffix: 3 -MMTAKE, 4 -MMSWPT, 5 -MMONLY, 6 -DSFTAKE (EU _SPDSFNICE), 7 -SWEEPOST, 8 -SWPSTDSF, 9 -AUTOROUTEDMA, 10 -SWPSTEOD, 11 -TAKE_MM, 12 -SWPST_MM, 13 -MMAUTOROUTEDMA, 14 EU dark sweep (_SPDSFNICE). In EU, 14 also keeps TAKE aggression for SHADOW/NINJA-like algos instead of downgrading to AGGR_PING.

example.explanation: Only take via SWEEPOST venues.

interactions.title: 172=14 keeps TAKE for EU shadow/ninja algos
interactions.explanation: adjustTAKE normally downgrades TAKE to AGGR_PING for EU likeShadowNinja algos; takeVenue 14 is the exception.

name: Passive only
description: Forbids taking and optionally other venue types. Value = mode*100 + level. Level: 1 no TAKE; 2 no TAKE, no pmid/dark; 3 no restriction in venue filter; 4 no pmid/dark; 5 no TAKE, no primary; 6 no TAKE/primary/pmid/dark; 7 no TAKE/pmid; 8 no TAKE/primary/pmid; 9 no pmid. With a portfolio dollar cap levels 1-10 become 11-20 (only round-lot TAKE blocked). Mode 0 (default) also zeroes min/hard candidate size; mode 1 (e.g. 101) keeps hard size.

example.explanation: Post only on lit venues, never take, no midpoint/dark.

interactions.title: HK short sells forced passive-only (173=2)
interactions.explanation: Rules write 173=2 (and 15=1 for VWAP/TMX, 15=0 otherwise) for HK non-ETF short sells, overriding any client 173.

interactions.title: Reg SHO restricted short sells set 173=1
interactions.explanation: Rule writes 173=1 and PPL=1 for short sells under Reg SHO restriction.

interactions.title: Grab mode (156) defaults 173=0
interactions.explanation: When 156 is set and 173 is not, rule sets 173=0.

interactions.title: 173=2 with queue mode zeroes max candidate size
interactions.explanation: If passive_only==2 and queue_mode (154) > 0, candidate maxsize is set to 0.

name: Relay 9060 id
description: String id stored as id_relay9060; no reader of id_relay9060() was found outside the accessor, so its effect is unknown.

example.explanation: Relay id R1 (effect not visible in source).

name: Reload relay 9060
description: When > 0, on a new (non-addition) fixmsg the engine reloads the algo relay map and fix-message config if the basket id, group id or 9001 changed since the last reload, or relay_reload_sleep ms elapsed.

example.explanation: Reload relay and ai.fixmsg config before applying them.

name: Dark chunk size factor
description: Caps the size of each dark/liquidity-seeking (LC) child order to dark_size x average trade size.

example.explanation: Dark child orders at most 2x the average trade size.

name: Buy back
description: Share buy-back order flag with optional exchange: '1' (US) or '2[,exch]' (EU, exchange defaults to the stock's exchange). Engine pulls end time 10/30 min before continuous end (mode 1), disables open/close custom tags, and caps size at buyback_max_limit x ADV minus already-bought (mode 2 also by the exchange's ADV).

example.explanation: EU buy back capped by XLON ADV.

interactions.title: Buy back on a sale rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'buy back on a sale'.

interactions.title: Buy back with auction participation rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'buy back participates in open or close auction' when doClose or doOpen > 0.

interactions.title: Region mismatch rejects
interactions.explanation: EU requires 177=2, NA requires 177=1; EU mode 2 rejects if no ADV for the buy-back exchange.

interactions.title: Buy back on stock without ADV/prevclose/market cap rejects
interactions.explanation: setBuyBackEndTime rejects when adv<1, no prev close, market cap<1, or the modified end time is before start.

name: Max execution gap (minutes)
description: If no fill has happened for more than this many (trading) minutes, the order regulator forces a catch-up goal of one round lot more.

example.explanation: Force a fill if 10 minutes pass without execution.

interactions.title: LINE/PASS default 178=10
interactions.explanation: Rule sets 178=10 for LINE and PASS when unset.

name: Min lit participation level
description: Minimum participation rate (percent) on lit volume. Validated against minpart_reject_min and against max lit part level; halved for large PART2 orders; split across sub-orders for split algos.

example.explanation: Participate at least 5% of lit volume.

algorithmDependent.behavior: Overwritten by the target lit participation level after 9012 parsing, and halved for large/small-cap PART2 orders.

interactions.title: Min lit > max lit rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'min lit part level > max lit part level' (also 'too small' below minpart_reject_min).

interactions.title: PART2 replaces 179 with target lit level
interactions.explanation: After parsing, PART2 sets _minlitpartlevel = _targetlitpartlevel.

interactions.title: Turns on large-print filter multiplier 1
interactions.explanation: size_cutoff_multiplier() defaults to 1.0 when min part or min lit part level > 0.

name: Auction duration split (DT auction)
description: Per-auction duration-dependent settings: groups separated by '&', each '[O|C|PO/PMO,...:]minutes_value,...,value' giving thresholds (order duration minutes) and values for open, close and PM-open auctions; the last entry without '_' applies to any longer duration. Parsed into open/close/pmopen dur_split/dur_value arrays.

example.explanation: Open/close value 1 if duration<=120 min, 3 if <=240, else 5.

interactions.title: TMX default auction split
interactions.explanation: Rule writes 180=O:120_1,240_3,5&C:120_1,240_3,5 for TMX/OPETMX.

name: Synthetic iceberg mode
description: Controls synthetic iceberg (engine-managed display) for orders with an iceberg size. >0 makes candidate size equal to the iceberg size and enables IcebergSOR/ICENINJA synthetic handling; 1 also trims a work order to its display size. If unset, AlgoConfig synthetic_iceberg_mode (default 1) applies only on synthetic_iceberg_markets (default GA).
default: -1 -> AlgoConfig synthetic_iceberg_mode=1 on synthetic_iceberg_markets (GA), else off

example.explanation: Show only the iceberg display size, replenishing synthetically.

algorithmDependent.behavior: PostWorker uses tryIceNinja when iceberg size > 0 and mode > 0.

name: Dark limit price mode
description: 'mode[,range]' enabling a candidate-supplied dark limit price. Mode > 0: each candidate must carry a darklimit, otherwise its sizes are zeroed ('ignoring candidate with no dark limit'); IoI dark posting waits for a dark limit. Range is absolute or 'S<n>' = n x spread.

example.explanation: Require a dark limit from the candidate.

interactions.title: Sensato low-alpha large orders get 182=1
interactions.explanation: Sensato algo-wheel rules write 182=1 for large orders, so candidates without a dark limit will not trade.

name: Lit limit price mode
description: 'mode[,range]' enabling a candidate-supplied lit limit price. Mode > 0: candidates without a litlimit get zero size; PostWorker applies the lit limit. Range absolute or 'S<n>' x spread.

example.explanation: Require lit limit; range two spreads.

interactions.title: 387 without 183 breaks parsing
interactions.explanation: The 387 (second lit limit) block splits _lit_limit_price_str (183) instead of its own string, so 387 alone throws a NullPointerException and 387 always copies 183's mode.

name: Size cutoff multiplier
description: Multiplier for the large-print filter: prints larger than multiplier x cutoff size (166/stock) are excluded from participation volume (outside auctions). A value > 0 also marks the multiplier as tag-supplied so it beats the config use_size_cuttoff.
default: AlgoConfig use_size_cuttoff=1; 1.0 when min part levels are set

example.explanation: Ignore prints larger than twice the cutoff size.

interactions.title: 184 overrides config use_size_cuttoff
interactions.explanation: With size_cutoff_intag>0 the tag multiplier is used before config use_size_cuttoff.

name: Cleanup spread threshold
description: Spread condition for end-of-order cleanup in ConcertStrategy: 'bps[,ticks]' (also '&'). Cleanup allowed only if spread <= ticks x tick size or < bps. Negative bps disables cleanup; 0 means always allowed.

example.explanation: Clean up only if spread <= 2 ticks or < 10 bps.

interactions.title: MFSIS converted to LINE with cleanup disabled
interactions.explanation: Rule writes ALGO=LINE, 185=-1 for 88=MFSIS.

name: PEG take mode
description: How a PEG order takes within its take discretion (132): 0 stop pegging and take all workable shares; 1 take the candidate size; >1 skips PegWorker take and uses ConcertStrategy handlePEGTakeDiscretion instead.

example.explanation: Take only the candidate size.

interactions.title: Needs a take discretion (132)
interactions.explanation: Both paths require peg_take_discretion_cps() > 0, derived from 132.

name: PVWAP order start
description: Integer stored as pvwap_order_start; only echoed in the parameter dump in the source read.

example.explanation: pvwap_order_start=1 (no visible effect).

name: CIS switch time
description: For IIS orders, switches to another algo at a time: '[T|unit,]time'. Converts the order into a compound time-tracked config (mode 3): IIS until the time, then the algo in 189 (default PCAP), copying all other 9012 tags.

example.explanation: Run IIS until 13:00 then switch to PCAP.

interactions.title: IIS converted to compound IIS -> 189 algo
interactions.explanation: convertCIS sets compound_algo_mode=3 and builds the compound config.

interactions.title: Malformed CIS time rejects
interactions.explanation: A single letter-led field (or unit with empty time) sets _err_msg 'Wrong CIS parameter'.

interactions.title: Ignored for non-IIS
interactions.explanation: convertCIS returns unless the algorithm is IIS.

name: CIS switch algo
description: Algo (and extra tags separated by '/') to switch to at the CIS time (188). Default PCAP.

example.explanation: Switch to VWAP with 6=10.

interactions.title: Needs 188
interactions.explanation: Used only by convertCIS, which needs 188 and IIS.

name: Volume profile type
description: Selects the volume profile model: 5, 10, 20 mapped to '05d', '10d', '20d' (days of history); other values used verbatim; 0 = default.

example.explanation: Use the 10-day volume profile.

name: Size filter quote multiplier
description: Raises the large-print filter to at least multiplier x average quote size. Beats config sizefilter_quote_multiplier (default 0); only applies when a size filter exists.

example.explanation: Filter >= 5x avg quote size.

interactions.title: Config sets 191=0.001 when 166 is set
interactions.explanation: Keeps the filter equal to the explicit cutoff.

name: Must EOD
description: End-of-day completion: 'mode[,lead_ms]'. >0 at EOD lets the order work the full scheduler size; 2/3 disable taking at EOD and keep posts until close; 3 also sizes EOD orders to all available shares. Lead time (ms) overrides the EOD venue buffer (EODBN/1685).

allowedValues.meaning: no take at EOD, post to close
as 2 plus EOD orders use all available

example.explanation: Finish via EOD venue, buffer 10 s.

interactions.title: Lead time overrides EODBN; modes 2/3 override SPB
interactions.explanation: eod_venue_buffer_min() returns lead time first; postpool_zero_before_close() returns 0 for 2/3.

name: Opportunistic finish
description: Finish at the inside price when conditions hold (Statics.checkOpportunisticFinishChance, not in source): 'mode[,dollar_limit|price][,percent_order][,bps]'. Mode 4 takes a price. Defaults from AlgoConfig maps (dollar '2 5e4', percent '3 50').

example.explanation: Opportunistically finish with config limits.

interactions.title: FMRPOP/KSPOP rules set 193=2
interactions.explanation: Client-algo rules write 193=2 with LINE.

name: Dark venue flag (randomisable)
description: Integer stored as darkVenue. Values >=100 are randomised at parse time: with probability (value-100)% the flag becomes 1, otherwise 0 (A/B switch). No reader of darkVenue() was found in the engine source, so the flag currently has no visible effect.
valueFormat: int (0/1, or 100+p for p% random chance of 1)

example.explanation: 50% chance the flag is set to 1.

name: Dark mid-price mode
description: When >0, dark/mid-point child prices are not snapped to the venue tick grid on venues that allow off-tick prices (offTickMode>0), so true mid prices can be sent; also NEWSHADOW dark limits are shifted by half a tick and would-dark orders without IOI skip a price check. When 0, prices are rounded to the closest valid tick.

allowedValues.meaning: allow off-tick mid prices on off-tick venues

default: 0 in code; ai.fixmsg.properties:371 sets 195=1 for every order whose algorithm is not MOO/MOC/PAIR when unset

example.explanation: Send dark orders at exact mid-price where the venue supports off-tick prices.

algorithmDependent.behavior: dark limit moved half a tick more aggressive (LCWorker.java:671)

interactions.title: Rule defaults 195=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:371 sets 195=1 on all non MOO/MOC/PAIR orders that do not carry 195, so off-tick mid pricing is effectively the default.

interactions.title: Only effective on off-tick venues
interactions.explanation: Tick snapping is skipped only if the venue/exchange offTickMode>0; otherwise prices are still rounded.

name: Start take mode
description: Controls the one-shot START take (opening take attempt at order start). 1: a custom START candidate is dropped if a start take was already tried. 2: the strategy itself fires a start take on the configured start venue (start_mode_venue) once, and repeated START work orders are allowed. Values <2 close repeat START work orders as invalid.

allowedValues.meaning: skip START custom candidate if already tried
strategy issues start take on start_mode_venue once

example.explanation: Fire one immediate take on the start venue when the order begins.

interactions.title: Mode 2 needs a valid start venue
interactions.explanation: With 196=2 the take is sent only if start_mode_venue() is a valid, usable venue.

name: Ladder parameters
description: Converts the order into a price-triggered compound ('ladder'): pairs of price,value. The first price is the base; each further price must be monotonically better (lower for buys, higher for sells) and its value replaces tag 9 (or 6, or 7, whichever the order uses) for the leg triggered at that price. All other 9012 tags are copied into each leg; the engine builds a 'C,4,...' compound config.

example.explanation: Buy: rate 5 at 10.00, 10 below 9.90, 20 below 9.80.

interactions.title: Ladder converts order to compound
interactions.explanation: convertLadder builds a compound config (mode 4, price trigger) with one leg per price level, using the original algorithm.

interactions.title: Invalid ladder rejects
interactions.explanation: Odd number of fields or fewer than 2 gives 'LADDER parameters invalid'; non-monotonic prices give 'LADDER prices not monotonically better' (_err_msg).

interactions.title: Ladder values replace tag 9/6/7
interactions.explanation: Each ladder value is written as tag 9 if present, else 6, else 7; those tags are excluded from the copied tag set.

name: Compound price mode
description: Mode passed to quote.lastPrice(side, mode) when compound/relay logic evaluates the current price against price triggers (compound trackers and RelayScheduler). Exact mode meanings are defined in the quote implementation, not visible here.

example.explanation: Use alternate reference price mode for compound price triggers.

name: PT flag
description: Free string stored as pt_flag. No reader of pt_flag() was found in the engine source, so its purpose cannot be determined (name suggests a program-trade flag).

example.explanation: Stored only.

name: Use EQTE post-loud venue
description: When >0, the order may use the EQTE-POST-LOUD venue. If that venue is not configured or is shut off for the order, the flag is reset to 0 at portfolio issue.

example.explanation: Allow posting to EQTE.

interactions.title: Disabled if EQTE unavailable
interactions.explanation: If exchange EQTE-POST-LOUD is missing or shut off, use_eqte is set to 0.

name: Use DQTE (closing quote venue) mode
description: Selects use of the DQTE closing-quote venue. 1: use DQTE as the MOC (CLOSE aggression). 2: extra dquote (QMOC) candidates from the scheduler, MOC not converted. >=3: DQTE used as extra candidate with size from the OPE imbalance feed, not the scheduler; regular MOC candidates are blocked and doClose is set to 0. For >=3 the 2nd/3rd fields give the QMOC match rate and imbalance rate in percent. If no DQTE venue exists the mode is reset to 0.

allowedValues.meaning: OPE smart close via DQTE (7 has extra special handling)

default: 0; crate default qclose_crate+20*aggression, irate default qclose_irate+30*aggression (clamped 0-100)

example.explanation: Smart close on DQTE: 20% of matched, 10% of imbalance.

interactions.title: Mode>=3 disables regular close
interactions.explanation: doClose set to 0 and MOC/MOC368 candidates are not processable (OPE smart close takes over).

interactions.title: No DQTE venue resets mode
interactions.explanation: If no DQTE exchange is found, use_dqte is reset to 0 (and doClose may be set to 0 for scheduled/IIS orders starting after pre-close end).

name: Dual-listing trade/take mode
description: For stocks with a dual listing, enables trading on the dual-listed line. Field 1 (dual_trade): >0 adds dual-code venues and dual ADV to the routing/post-loud decision; >1 also uses dual quotes. Field 2 (dual_take) controls takes: on dual venues takes are blocked if 1 or 2; on home venues takes are blocked if <=0, or allowed only on venues with a dual-code set if 1. Ignored when the stock has no dual listing.
default: dual_trade 0; dual_take from OEO config dual_take(stock)

example.explanation: Use dual venues for posting; no takes on home venues per code.

interactions.title: Ignored without dual listing
interactions.explanation: Parsed only if the stock has a dual stock; otherwise dual_trade is forced to 0.

interactions.title: Dual venues need dual ADV ratio
interactions.explanation: Dual venues are added to tradeable list only if dualAdvRatio > config dual_adv_rmin.

name: Flag-list (set alias tags to 1)
description: Comma-separated list of non-numeric tag names (aliases); each one is set to '1' in the 9012 tag map, i.e. a shorthand for switching on several boolean alias tags at once. Numeric entries are ignored.

example.explanation: Equivalent to RLMOO=1^LOOO=1.

interactions.title: Sets listed alias tags to 1
interactions.explanation: Each non-numeric entry is put into _tag9012map with value 1, which can override or feed rules that check those aliases.

name: Static dark limit
description: Double stored as static_dark_limit. No reader of static_dark_limit() was found in the source, so it appears to have no effect.

example.explanation: Stored only.

name: PM open rate
description: Double stored as pmopen_rate (presumably afternoon/PM open auction participation rate). No reader of pmopen_rate() was found in the source.
default: 0 in code; ai.fixmsg.properties:60 sets 205=100 for SDMA orders when unset

example.explanation: Stored only.

interactions.title: Rule sets 205=100 for SDMA
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:60 defaults 205=100 on SDMA orders; no engine reader found.

name: MOO mode
description: Controls how the open auction (MOO) portion is handled. 1[,t,u]: MOO issued t seconds before the open start and updated every u seconds via OEO (if both >0). 2: MOO handled by OEO/strategy and the order is not marked open-done after MOO candidates. 3[,f]: smart open with rate type defaulting to 1 (or 3 if no indicated open), f = fraction of theoretical open volume. 0: no MOO mode. Forced to 0 when the order does not do the open (doOpen<=0) and returns 0 whenever 217 (moo_rate_type) is set.
default: 0; moo_update_period field 10; ai.fixmsg.properties:96-98 default 3 for PCAP, 2 for VWAP/TMX/PART/NINJA/ICENINJA/LINE/PASS, 1,30,10 for most others

example.explanation: Send MOO 30 s before open, refresh every 10 s.

interactions.title: 217 overrides 206
interactions.explanation: moo_mode() returns 0 whenever moo_rate_type (217) >0, so 206 is ignored.

interactions.title: No effect without open participation
interactions.explanation: setDoOpen forces moo_mode to 0 when doOpen<=0; also 0 when 9014 says not in open or open excluded.

interactions.title: Rule zeros 206 for orders far from open
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:103 sets 206=0 when the order starts more than 2h before the open.

interactions.title: Rule zeros 206 for low-rate SHADOW
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:104 sets 206=0.

interactions.title: Mode 3 implies rate type
interactions.explanation: With mode>=3 and no 217, moo_rate_type() returns 1 (3 if no indicated open), activating smart-open sizing.

name: Would-dark price
description: Would price for dark-only opportunistic (would) orders, same price syntax as tag 10 (IWouldPrice; a leading 'M' means multi-level MultIWouldPrice). If tag 11 (would venue) is not set, 207 implies dark-only would (11=1), or dark+lit (11=3) if tag 10 is also given. Invalid values reject the order.
valueFormat: would price string as in tag 10 (e.g. B-10, M...)

example.explanation: Would-dark when price is 5 bps better than reference (format as tag 10).

interactions.title: 207 implies would venue
interactions.explanation: Without tag 11, would venue becomes 1 (dark only), or 3 (dark+lit) when tag 10 is present.

interactions.title: Bad would-dark price rejects
interactions.explanation: Unparseable value sets _err_msg 'incorrect would dark price tag'.

name: Would-dark percentage
description: Limits how much of the order would-dark can execute. Plain number <=100 is a percent of order; >100 or suffix 'S' is a share count converted to percent of order size (capped 100). Prefix 'C' sets mode 1, 'R' mode 2 (value used as percentage directly, capped 100). Suffix 'S' also makes the would-dark hard size round up to lot.

example.explanation: Would-dark at most 5000 shares.

interactions.title: Meaningful with would-dark
interactions.explanation: Caps sizes of would-dark (e.g. 207) orders.

name: Close-only feature
description: Makes the order trade only in the closing auction. Effective for IIS algorithms when >0, for any algorithm when =9, and always on for MOC algorithms. Then close scheduling/OEO close logic handles the order (non-close candidates suppressed when sched_moc_mode>0). Value 9 has special handling in close sizing.

example.explanation: Execute only in the close auction.

interactions.title: Only 9 works for non-IIS algos
interactions.explanation: close_only_feature() is true for non-IIS, non-MOC algos only when the value is 9.

name: Stop-loss parameters
description: Converts the order into a price-triggered compound for stop-loss: p0,p1[,p2]. The order runs its normal algorithm (limit p0 if >0) until price crosses trigger p1, then switches to the stop-loss algorithm (tag 211, default NINJA^4=1) with limit p2. p2 may be 'A<price>' absolute, 'C<cents>' or 'B<bps>'/number bps offset from p1.

example.explanation: No limit initially; once price crosses 9.50, run the stop-loss algo (211) with a limit 5 cents beyond 9.50 in the order direction.

interactions.title: Stop-loss converts to compound
interactions.explanation: convertStopLoss builds a 'C,4' price-trigger compound; second leg runs tag 211 algo (default NINJA^4=1).

interactions.title: Fewer than 2 fields rejects
interactions.explanation: 'Stop loss parameters invalid'.

interactions.title: SLn aliases used only when 210 absent
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:237-239 copy SL4/SL5/SL6 into tags 4/5/6 for compound children only when 210 is NOT set; with 210 present those aliases are not copied.

name: Stop-loss algorithm
description: Algorithm (with optional sub-tags, ';' converted to '^') used for the stop-loss leg created by tag 210.

example.explanation: After stop triggers, run PART at 20%.

interactions.title: Ignored without 210
interactions.explanation: Only used inside convertStopLoss, which returns early if 210 is absent.

name: Part mode
description: When >0, disables the OPE participation-rate check (checkPartRate) in the candidate regulator for the lag side of a cash/pair order. Also exported as PART_MODE in order info.

example.explanation: Skip lag-side participation rate check.

interactions.title: Only matters with cash lag side
interactions.explanation: checkPartRate only runs when cash_lag_side (130) is 1 or 2 and matches the side.

name: Clean pipe mode
description: Restricts dark venues by their 'clean pipe' attribute. 0: exclude clean-pipe venues; 1: only clean-pipe venues; 3/13: alternate clean/dirty work modes (13 adds timing based on last dark fill); 10/20: clean/dirty switching that turns off mid-point venues in work mode 1; 63: also disables post-loud. Value >0 overrides the default cleanpipe for dark venue selection.

example.explanation: Set by APSHADOW presets (ai.fixmsg.properties:344-346).

interactions.title: 63 disables post loud
interactions.explanation: noPostLoud() returns true when cleanPipe==63 (unless always_post_loud).

interactions.title: APSHADOW presets set 213=2
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:344-346.

name: ICENINJA post all
description: When >0 on an ICENINJA order, the candidate processor posts all (non-NA) candidates rather than iceberg slices.

example.explanation: ICENINJA posts full size.

interactions.title: Only ICENINJA
interactions.explanation: Checked together with algotype()==ICENINJA.

name: Dark passive mode
description: Selects dark venues by their passive attribute: 1 = passive dark venues only; -1 (input 11) = aggressive dark venues; 0 = neutral; 2 = special LC worker handling; 3/5 = dynamic passive switching (with dark_passive_mode), 4 = passive-venue variant; 3 also falls back to neutral when no passive.

example.explanation: Only passive dark pools.

interactions.title: APSHADOW presets set 215
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:344 (215=1) and 348 (215=-1).

name: Prefer inverted posts
description: Preference for inverted (taker-maker) venues when posting: first field sign (+/-) with optional weight. Weight defaults to config plus_/minus_prefer_inverted_posts_weight. No reader outside Parameters was found, so the effect is not visible in this source.

example.explanation: Prefer inverted venues with weight 2.

name: MOO rate type (smart open)
description: Smart open auction sizing type: rate type[,max type[,min type]]. 1 = rate of imbalance theoretical volume, 2 = relative to estimated volume, 3 = historical volume, 5 = ADV, 11 = ML_OPENPR full size at 218 rate, 30-39 = ADV%/size% caps, 100 = fraction of order size, 200 = fixed shares. Max/min types bound size with 218's 2nd/3rd fields. When set and the stock has not opened (and 220=0), the order is relayed as SMART_OPEN/SMOO for the auction.
default: 0 (off); with 206>=3 effective type 1 (3 if no indicated open); max type 5 if 218 field 2 set

example.explanation: Open auction size = 218% of indicated volume.

interactions.title: Smart open relay (SMOO)
interactions.explanation: moo_rate_type>0 with stop_after_moo=0 and stock not opened sets relay algo SMART_OPEN; child is relayed as SMOO.

interactions.title: 217 overrides 206
interactions.explanation: moo_mode() returns 0 when 217>0.

interactions.title: KO with 14=0
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:513 rejects orders with 217/218 and 14=0 (no open).

interactions.title: Zeroed when start time given
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:101-102 set 217=218=219=0 when start_to_moo>0 and an explicit start time (9002 or 9012 tag 2) is given, cancelling smart-open sizing.

interactions.title: Needs 218 rate
interactions.explanation: Size computed from moo_rate (218); without it moo_rate is -1.

name: MOO rate
description: Open-auction rate (percent) used with 217: rate[,second[,third]]. For 217 types outside 30-39 the 2nd field is the max rate and 3rd the min rate (bounded by 217's max/min types); for 30-39 the 2nd is % of ADV cap and 3rd % of order size cap.

example.explanation: 20% of auction volume, capped at 33% by max type.

interactions.title: Needs 217 (or 206>=3)
interactions.explanation: Rate used only when a moo rate type is active.

interactions.title: KO with 14=0
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:513.

name: Imbalance-open rate
description: Rate (percent) for the opening imbalance-offset worker (IMBO): with an active smart open (217 in 1..39) and 219>0, an imbalance worker trades against the open imbalance.

example.explanation: Offset 10% of open imbalance.

interactions.title: Needs 217 in 1..39
interactions.explanation: Imbalance worker created only when moo_rate_type in (0,40) and imbo_rate>0 (or layered SMOO).

name: Stop after MOO
description: When >0 the order only participates in the open auction: non-MOO candidates are not processed, and once the stock has opened the order is rejected/stopped (STOP_AFTER_MOO). Also prevents smart-open relay.
default: 0; ai.fixmsg.properties:462 sets 1 for HK SDMA/ICEDMA market orders starting before continuous open

example.explanation: Open auction only.

interactions.title: Order ends after open
interactions.explanation: Rejected with STOP_AFTER_MOO once stock opened; only MOO candidates processed.

interactions.title: Blocks smart-open relay
interactions.explanation: SMART_OPEN relay only when stop_after_moo==0.

interactions.title: HK DMA market orders default 220=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:462.

name: Imbalance-open rate type
description: Type of the opening imbalance worker: 1 = run the imbalance worker with DAY TIF on continuous venues; other values route to IMBO aggression venues with OPG TIF. Mode 0 with pre-open ending at continuous start uses a different worker set-up.

example.explanation: Imbalance worker uses DAY orders.

interactions.title: Needs 219
interactions.explanation: Only used when an imbalance worker exists (219>0).

name: Stock resume delay
description: Delay (minutes) before resuming trading after a stock halt ends. Plain number applies to all halt types; 'k:m' sets m minutes for halt type k (0-5); unspecified types fall back to the plain value. Applied only if the halt lasted longer than config min_halt_time (when configured).

example.explanation: 5 min after halts, 10 min after halt type 2.

name: Volume smoothing
description: factor[,catchup_rate]. Volume smoothing factor for participation: when >0 and quotes valid, the engine adds a portion of the opposite quote size (scaled by factor/catch-up rate) to smooth the market-volume estimate. Catch-up rate defaults to config volume_smooth_rate, else the order minPartLevel.
default: 0; ai.fixmsg.properties:84 sets 223=1 for orders with minPartLevel>0

example.explanation: Smooth with factor 1, catch-up rate 10%.

interactions.title: Rule forces 223=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:84 sets 223=1 when minPartLevel>0 (overwrites any value).

name: Volume profile symbol
description: Symbol(s) whose volume profile is used for scheduling instead of the order's own symbol ('ex' maps to the profile group default). Defaults to 'symbol,dualSym' when dual-list volume counting is enabled.

example.explanation: Use the exchange/profile-group default profile.

name: Volume profile averaging mode
description: Integer stored as vprof_avg_mode; no reader of vprof_avg_mode() was found in the source, so effect unknown.

example.explanation: Stored only.

name: Fair price limit
description: Dynamic 'fair' limit: mode,msig0,msig1,tmin_ms,tmax_ms,tnt,sigma_min,sigma_max. With mode 1 the engine tracks a fair mid price and caps the order's limit at fair price +/- msig spreads/volatility (combined with any client limit: tighter wins). tmin/tmax/tnt bound the time window (tnt trades), sigma_min/max bound volatility.
default: AlgoConfig plim_mode 0, msig0 5, msig1 2, tmin 3000, tmax 300000, tnt 25, sigma_min 0.0025, sigma_max 0.025; ai.fixmsg.properties:86 sets 226=1,50,50,1000,300000 when unset

example.explanation: Fair limit on with wide 50-sigma bands.

interactions.title: Tightens client limit
interactions.explanation: withinLimit uses min(fair,limit) for buys / max for sells; fair limit used if no limit.

interactions.title: Rule enables fair limit by default
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:86 sets 226=1,50,50,1000,300000 on every order that does not carry 226, so a fair limit is active on effectively all orders.

name: Preferred venue
description: Regex of preferred venue ids, optional weight, optional mode. Weight is absolute, or 'xa' = x times average weight of other venues, 'xt' = x times total. Mode 0 updates selection weight only, 1 updates size scale (more shares), 2 both. Default weight 0.5 when only pattern given.

example.explanation: Prefer CHIX venues with 2x average weight and more size.

name: Emergency take venue
description: Venue id to use for emergency takes; only take-aggression venues with this id qualify, and it must be enabled for the order. Defaults per exchange code from AlgoConfig emergency_take_venue map.
default: AlgoConfig emergency_take_venue (per exchange code), else none

example.explanation: Emergency takes via TSE-TAKE.

name: Post-fill reaction
description: reaction[,tick[,spread[,dtmin_ms[,dtmax_ms[,ntrade]]]]]. Reaction 1 = chase: after a post fill, replenish hot venues (tryReplenish). 2 = pause: record the post fill price as a limit (limitPostFill). Other fields (tick 1, spread 0.5, dtmin 6000, dtmax 60000, ntrade 10) are stored; dtmax forced >= dtmin.

example.explanation: Pause posting relative to last post fill price.

name: FX-denominated limit price
description: Limit price in another currency: [currency,]price[,mode,offset][;range]. Currency defaults to USD. Mode (0 last, 1 mid, 2 passive, 3 aggressive quote) and offset govern the FX conversion. When valid, strategies do nothing until the converted FX limit is available.
default: currency USD; mode AlgoConfig limitprice_fx_mode 2; offset 0.01

example.explanation: Limit 1500 JPY converted to listing currency.

interactions.title: Trading waits for FX price
interactions.explanation: If limitprice_fx_valid() and no FX limit is available, the strategy returns without trading.
